up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, and indication details (MeSH heading and EFO term) for all approved drugs indicated for prostate cancer. Approved drugs are defined as those with max_phase = 4 or therapeutic_flag = 1 in the molecule_dictionary table. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno to filter for indications where mesh_heading or efo_term contains 'prostate cancer'. Also join with compound_structures on molregno to obtain the canonical SMILES. Return one row per distinct drug-indication combination.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE (md.max_phase = 4 OR md.therapeutic_flag = 1) AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%prostate cancer%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%prostate cancer%')
